svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — Observer and adaptive planning

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — Observer and adaptive planning
+communication(e: Event, channel: Channel, tone: String): Communication
applyChanges notifies observers inline; no notifyObservers()
or removeObserver() method exists. Formal F08 changes also
Observer callback rechecks with empty other-event workload.
Revalidation retains plans and sets advisory warnings.
